Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he flagged it on ticket #8841 for support. His message doesn't name the account, though. He was answering Hollis's question about "Tobias's dealer account". Linking that to Marrow Fieldworks is my inference: a public January handoff digest says the account was Pree's and changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. So I told her it's worth checking with Tobias before the call.

The gbrain search didn't run: the brain refused it because this connection isn't tied to any member. I worked only from what Pree can see herself, which is #central-team, #central-random and the public files. No Marrow Fieldworks ticket files showed up in the share.
